title: Okta Management API token (SSWS): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix namespace: 01 vs the 00 the provider's own SSWS example begins with (developer.okta.com: "Authorization: SSWS 00QCjAl4MlV-WPXM...0HmjFx-vbGua"). Twin of "Okta Management API token (SSWS): must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
